meta_analysis_rules: ALAN and enhanced UV-B remain separate exposure classes.
Visitation, pollen delivery, fruit success, seed/ovule fraction and total seed output are separate outcomes.
Observational light gradients and randomized/manipulated lighting are separate design strata.
Author group or paper DOI does not prove independent experimental units.
No shared global estimate is reported without effect-level estimates, variance and dependence accounting.
Do not require every source to observe every moderator; retain outcome-specific usable subsets with explicit unknowns.
